in_hindi.name: धनजय
in_hindi.long_meaning: धनी हुए जिसने पसंद आया है जय (The one who became wealthy and was victorious)

in_marathi.name: Dhanajay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth and victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanajay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhanajay is derived from two Sanskrit words, Dhan (meaning wealth) and Jay (meaning victory). The name signifies a person who has the power and wealth to achieve victory.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of wealth and victory
